 We've only just recovered from a huge weekend of eating. Halloween obviously means a whole lot of sweets and chocolates, but it also means BOGO offers, limited-edition drops, steep discounts, and genuinely free giveaways from a number of restaurant chains.
 Didn't make the most of those offers? Don't fret, because National Sandwich Day takes place on Nov. 3.
 We've scanned the market for all of the deals that make events like this so special. We're seeing limited-time offers from the likes of Subway, 7-Eleven, Capriotti’s, Potbelly, and more of your favorite spots this week.
 Check out some of our favorites below:
 National Sandwich Day 2026 food deals
 7-Eleven
 7Rewards and Speedy Rewards members can grab a $1 fountain drink or Big Gulp with the purchase of any sandwich on Nov. 3.
 Big Buns
 Enter promo code SAMMIEDAY at checkout online or mention it in-store on Nov. 3 to unlock a BOGO 50% off deal across all chicken sandwich builds.
 Capriotti’s
 CapAddicts Rewards members score BOGO 50% off on all sub sizes for National Sandwich Day on Nov. 3 (redeemable in-store, online, or via the Capriotti's mobile app).
 Farmer Boys
 Loyalty club members can pick up a Bacon Turkey Melt for $5.99 on Nov. 3 and Nov. 4 when ordering in-restaurant or through the official Farmer Boys app (excludes combo upgrades and third-party delivery).
 Firehouse Subs
 Spend $15 or more on Nov. 3 via the Firehouse Subs app or website to score a free medium sub added to your order.

 Habit Burger
 Through Nov. 4, each Habit Burger location is giving away 50 free Gotta Habit Meals daily during a surprise one-hour window. App members get a two-hour early heads-up notification, while everyone else can track the daily drop time via Habit Burger’s official Instagram.
 Jersey Mike’s
 Skip the midday desk trek: Jersey Mike’s is offering free delivery on all orders of $5 or more placed through the mobile app or official website on Nov. 3.
 Jimmy John’s
 Rewards members can claim a digital BOGO Free sandwich on Nov. 3 by entering promo code SANDWICH at checkout in the Jimmy John’s app or website (single-use only; cannot be stacked with other discounts).
 Makers Union
 Makers Union is slashing prices across the entire board on Nov. 3 with a BOGO 50% off promo on all burgers, sandwiches, and handhelds.
 McAlister’s Deli
 Rewards members can snag a $5 regular sandwich (select exclusions apply) through Nov. 3 when ordering directly through McAlister's digital channels (limit one per member; not valid on catering or third-party delivery).
 Penn Station East Coast Subs
 Buy any regular sub, sandwich, wrap, or bowl on Nov. 3 and use coupon code NS26 online or in-app to get a free small sub.
 Pepsi x DoorDash
 Order via DoorDash on Nov. 3 or Nov. 4, build a cart of $25 or more that includes a Pepsi-Cola beverage, and you'll trigger an instant $15 discount at checkout.
 Potbelly
 Buy any Big or Original sandwich or wrap on Nov. 3 through the Potbelly app or website and use promo code BOGO to get a free Original-size sandwich or wrap.
 Quiznos
 New loyalty members who sign up for Quiznos Rewards around National Sandwich Day unlock $5 off their first mobile app order.
 Schlotzsky’s
 Schlotzsky’s Rewards members can purchase $5 medium sandwiches through Nov. 3, valid on up to 10 discounted sandwiches per transaction.
 Smoothie King
 If you want something lighter than a footlong, Smoothie King is serving up a $9.99 meal bundle that pairs any protein-packed Chicken Flatbread (Chipotle, Ranch, or Pesto) with a 20-oz. Fruit Classic smoothie.
 Subway
 Sub Club members can claim a free Footlong sandwich with the purchase of another Footlong through Nov. 8 when placing an order in the app or online.
